fact: The Directorate General of Taxes launched a three-day workshop on 15 April 2026, funded by AFD through PAGFSI, to prepare the progressive deployment of tax e-filing (télédéclaration) and e-payment (télépaiement) under the 2026 finance law.

The Directorate General of Taxes, with AFD support through PAGFSI, opened a three-day workshop on 15 April 2026 to validate the legal framework and prepare the progressive deployment of tax e-filing and e-payment.
